parsed.answer: This is a known Always On Top bug: when the module is enabled, apps with custom title-bar/system menus (PuTTY, RDP/mstsc) only show the basic Windows menu. The tickets are tracked under #46569 (Always On Top's border/menu handling replaces or corrupts the system menu, apparently because of a hard-coded assumption about the menu item count). Workarounds from those tickets: the only reliable one is to disable the Always On Top module entirely (excluding putty.exe in the exclusion list did not help, and neither did turning off 'Show Always on Top in the title bar context menu' for PuTTY). One RDP user reported that turning off a particular Always On Top setting (shown in a screenshot, not named in the text) fixed it. Windows already open before enabling AOT keep their full menu, so you can also start PuTTY first and enable AOT afterwards. Ctrl+Right-click inside the PuTTY window still shows the full PuTTY menu. I can't find a released fix in these tickets, so please follow #46569 for updates.
